authority_rule: Each reaction declares balanced inputs, outputs, catalysts, losses, energy conditions, machine authority, provenance transform, and runtime evidence.
review_scope: The rejected contracts below cover only the ten removed direct elemental-metal outputs. Every other authored transformation remains pending reaction-level balance and behavioral review; presence in source is not approval.

rejected_recipe_contracts.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: opaque item packets and probabilistic carbon-dioxide residue do not prove conserved iron, carbon, and oxygen quantities.

rejected_recipe_families.source_specificity_finding: Rejected: each periodic group reused one generic deposit selector for every member, so the input composition did not justify the selected element; the molecule subset likewise lacked accepted fixed-packet source contracts.
rejected_recipe_families.magic_provenance_finding: Rejected: LP and slate costs did not declare an identity-changing provenance transform or material-specific residue, including for radioactive species.
rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: probabilistic Create yields, multi-item Blood outputs, and item-to-gas volume conversion had no shared fixed-mass basis or complete residue accounting.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Rejected: Create and Blood Magic directly formed finished elemental metals reserved to TConstruct metallurgy.

rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: opaque one-item element, dust, and plate packets were treated as equal without an accepted common mass basis.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Rejected: Create milling and compacting directly formed or reclaimed finished elemental material reserved to TConstruct metallurgy and remelting.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: This disposition does not approve formula, compound-recovery, sink, or molecule-use generators.

rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: two opaque compound items were mapped to one opaque elemental item without a common fixed-mass basis or composition-derived stoichiometry.
rejected_recipe_families.residue_finding: Rejected: pressure seals were consumed while every non-target atom in the oxide, chloride, nitrate, sulfate, sulfide, carbonate, hydroxide, or phosphate input disappeared without a named residue.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Rejected: PNCR directly formed finished elemental material reserved to TConstruct metallurgy and remelting.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: This disposition does not approve formula creation, sinks, molecule-use generators, or the retained cross-script identity list.

rejected_recipe_families.source_purpose_finding: Rejected: every surviving element in a broad periodic group was accepted by the same one-or-two generic sink set even when its composition or physical properties had no material-specific relationship to the output.
rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: one opaque element packet plus unrelated components could yield multiplied glass, wire, fertilizer, grout, tubes, dust, or compost without a composition-derived fixed-mass account.
rejected_recipe_families.magic_provenance_finding: Rejected: the five biogenic Source Gem routes combined an arbitrary group element, amethyst, and a Blood slate without an identity-changing provenance transform or a named residue.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Rejected: machine selection followed group adjacency rather than a material-specific Create or PNCR operation contract.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: This disposition does not approve formula creation, molecule-use generators, terminal-output declarations, or the retained cross-script identity list.

rejected_recipe_families.source_composition_finding: Rejected: crop, wood, fungus, insect, animal, and monster inputs were mapped through ethanol to broad elemental or unrelated material outputs without source-specific composition evidence.
rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: multiple probabilistic outputs and probabilistic grinding-ball recovery used opaque item packets without a conserved fixed-mass basis.
rejected_recipe_families.purpose_finding: Rejected: grinding-ball bias changed the selected material identity to create graph adjacency rather than serving a material-specific extraction purpose.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: This disposition disables only ethanol; later solvent dispositions are recorded as separate rejected families.

rejected_recipe_families.source_composition_finding: Rejected: crop, wood, fungus, insect, animal, and monster inputs were mapped through acetic acid to carbon, carbon dioxide, sodium, calcium carbonate, or unrelated products without source-specific composition evidence.

rejected_recipe_families.purpose_finding: Rejected: grinding-ball bias changed the selected material identity to create graph adjacency rather than serving a material-specific extraction purpose.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: Ethanol, acetic acid, and sulfuric acid are disabled by separate dispositions; hydrochloric, nitric, and phosphoric families remain unapproved and pending separate review.
